analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (81,790 KRW) vs SMA5 (82,509 KRW) / SMA20 (87,787 KRW) / SMA50 (99,630 KRW): Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/SMA50, confirming entry into a weak phase.
· Significantly below SMA100 (107,316 KRW) / SMA200 (100,716 KRW): Continued weakening of long-term trend.
· 52-week position (28.2%): Approaching historical low levels, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.5 → 36.4): Entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (518.2180 → -544.3880): Bearish reversal and continued worsening, strengthening selling pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 78,751 KRW): Approaching the lower band, potential for testing support if further decline occurs.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (75,565 KRW): Above Pivot S1 (72,468 KRW), technical support expected.
· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW): Below SMA20 (87,787 KRW) and Pivot R1 (94,653 KRW), resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day high 92,360 KRW, 20-day high 98,195 KRW. 5-day low 76,010 KRW, 20-day low 76,010 KRW. Suggests potential for Lower High formation and sideways movement.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x): Subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing trend reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis: Continued downtrend and entry into a weak phase. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI oversold, MACD worsening, and subdued volume.
